units.source_text: 这是日本旅行协会印刷的一幅美丽的石版画，

en.t: This was a beautiful lithograph printed by the Japan Travel Association,

units.source_text: 画面是日本阿尔卑斯山①，
在蔚蓝的天空下浮现的白色山顶上，印着横写的"召唤你，到未知的世界去！"几个字。

en.t: and across the white peaks rising beneath the deep blue sky were printed the words, written horizontally: "Calling you to an unknown world!"

units.source_text: 柏木在这排校写的文字和山顶，用红笔使劲打了个斜十字，试图一笔涂抹掉，

en.t: Kashiwagi had drawn a forceful diagonal cross in red pencil over the horizontal lettering and the peaks, trying to wipe them out with a single stroke,

units.source_text: 并且在旁边潦草地写上："所谓未知的人生，委实令人难以忍受。"

en.t: and beside it he had scrawled: "This so-called unknown life is truly unbearable."

units.source_text: 这几个龙飞凤舞的字迹，马上让人联想到他那双X型的腿走路的模样。

en.t: Those wildly sprawling characters immediately called to mind the way he walked on his X-shaped legs.
